{{Quote|In their boldest action to date, Rebel terrorists attacked Brak sector's CommNet, disrupting communications throughout the sector.|A [[Brak Sector News]] report|<ref name="GNN9" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces '''attacked''' the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] [[Brak Sector CommNet|communications network]] in a coordinated strike, wiping out [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and civilian communications in the sector. While some relay stations and transmitters were attacked by heavily armed [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]], most of them were [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] to self-destruct. Nevertheless, most stations reported few casualties. The blackout was widespread but backup systems quickly came online. Heavily populated areas reported few problems but long distance communications were disrupted for several hours and some outlying areas remained isolated for nearly one day.
